requirements.condition: A packet is declared lost and it was sent after the earliest acknowledged packet in its packet number space.

requirements.condition: When a sender is ready to transmit a probe packet and the congestion controller would otherwise prevent transmission.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the probe packet to be transmitted without congestion-controller blocking.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The congestion controller MUST NOT block transmission of a probe packet.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A focused test can place the sender at its congestion limit, trigger probe transmission, and verify that the congestion controller does not suppress the probe.

evidence.quote: Probe packets MUST NOT be blocked by the congestion controller.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender MUST NOT omit probe packets from in-flight accounting or treat them as replacing already-counted in-flight packets.

requirements.condition: After probe packets are sent while their loss or delivery has not yet been established, and counting them raises bytes in flight above the congestion window.

requirements.condition: A sender establishes that every packet sent during a sufficiently long duration was lost.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender classifies the network as experiencing persistent congestion.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender must not leave the network classified as not experiencing persistent congestion once this condition is established.

evidence.quote:
When a sender establishes loss of all packets sent over a long enough

   congestion.

requirements.condition: When a sender computes the duration used to establish persistent congestion.
requirements.required_behavior: Compute the duration as (smoothed_rtt + max(4*rttvar, kGranularity) + max_ack_delay) multiplied by kPersistentCongestionThreshold.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use a different arithmetic expression for the persistent congestion duration.
requirements.error_behavior: No error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can supply RTT, RTT variation, granularity, acknowledgment-delay, and threshold values and compare the implementation's duration with the specified expression.

   (smoothed_rtt + max(4*rttvar, kGranularity) + max_ack_delay) *
       kPersistentCongestionThreshold

requirements.condition: When computing the persistent congestion duration for losses established in any packet number space.
requirements.required_behavior: Include max_ack_delay in the persistent congestion duration regardless of the packet number space in which the losses were established.

requirements.error_behavior: No error behavior is specified.

evidence.quote:

requirements.why_checkable: A test can induce consecutive PTO expirations without satisfying the duration-based loss condition and verify that they alone do not establish persistent congestion.

least one RTT sample.

Because the threshold was reached and

requirements.required_behavior: Start with an empty pc_lost collection and insert exactly the lost packets whose time_sent is strictly greater than first_rtt_sample.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not include a lost packet whose time_sent is equal to or earlier than first_rtt_sample, and do not retain candidates from a prior invocation.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary-value packets sent before, exactly at, and after first_rtt_sample can verify both fresh initialization and the strict-greater-than filter.

requirements.condition: InPersistentCongestion(pc_lost) evaluates true.
requirements.required_behavior: Set congestion_window to kMinimumWindow.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain a larger congestion window after persistent congestion is identified.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A candidate loss sequence that satisfies persistent congestion has a deterministic postcondition for congestion_window.

if (InPersistentCongestion(pc_lost)):

requirements.condition: InPersistentCongestion(pc_lost) evaluates true.

requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A persistent-congestion event has a deterministic postcondition for congestion_recovery_start_time independent of the window update.

requirements.condition: Initial or Handshake keys are discarded.
requirements.required_behavior: Stop counting packets sent in the corresponding discarded packet number space toward bytes in flight.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave packets from that discarded space counted in bytes_in_flight.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can discard each key type and compare bytes_in_flight before and after accounting for packets in its packet number space.
